# CareFind

> CareFind (https://carefind.app) is a healthcare discovery and social platform for Nigeria. People use it to find
> medicines and the pharmacies that stock them, compare prices, find pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, laboratories and
> verified healthcare professionals, and read health articles. Listings are kept up to date by the businesses
> themselves through CareHub, their operations system.

## Key pages

- [Medicines A to Z](https://carefind.app/search): every medicine listed by a pharmacy, each with a page showing which pharmacies have it, where, and the price when the pharmacy shows it. Example: https://carefind.app/drug/paracetamol
- [Healthcare directory](https://carefind.app/business-directory): pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses by state, each with address, phone, opening hours, products and reviews.
- [Health news and articles](https://carefind.app/news): articles by pharmacists, doctors and healthcare businesses.
- [Sitemap](https://carefind.app/sitemap.xml): every public page.

## Notes for assistants

- Prescription-only medicines are listed without prices: the pharmacist asks for a prescription.
- Prices and stock are set by each pharmacy and can change; link to the CareFind page so people see the current listing.
- Only verified healthcare professionals have public profile pages.
